info.name: RFIPL Inventory API
info.description:
Postman collection for testing the RFIPL Inventory module.

SETUP:
1. Import this file (File > Import)
2. baseUrl variable defaults to http://localhost:5000
3. Ensure sql/inventory.sql is imported and server running
4. WORKFLOW: Run 'Auth > Login' first. Login auto-saves your accessToken as a collection variable. All other requests use Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} automatically.
5. NOTE: Employees table must have at least one row (purchase requests, orders, GRN, QC, production, dispatch, transfer, adjustment, damage, tool assignments all reference employees(id)). Create one via the Employee API before testing those flows.
